items.title: Meeting with Labour Minister on anti-worker provisions in the new labour codes
items.summary: BMS raised anti-worker provisions in the new labour codes with the Labour and Employment Minister.

items.title: BMS delegation meets Textile Minister, raises workers' issues
items.summary: A BMS delegation met the Textile Minister to discuss worker-related problems; the minister responded positively.

items.title: Nationwide demonstrations on 17 August 2026
items.summary: BMS demonstrated nationwide for resolution of long-pending workers' problems and opposed the IR Code and OSH Code provisions.

items.title: 17 August observed as Demands Day at district and state headquarters
items.summary: All BMS units directed to hold dharnas and demonstrations at district headquarters, state headquarters and industrial estates.

items.title: 15th BRICS Trade Union Forum Summit 2026 concludes with the Hyderabad Declaration
items.summary: BMS hosted the summit, which unanimously adopted the Hyderabad Declaration for a worker-centric global order.

items.title: BMS will not participate in the 12 February 2026 general strike
items.summary: BMS stated it does not support the strike, which it described as politically motivated.

items.title: New BMS national leadership elected
items.summary: Shri S. Mallesham elected President and Shri Surendra Kumar Pandey General Secretary of the new committee.

items.title: Air India Express crisis: BMS asks Civil Aviation Ministry to examine
items.summary: BMS noted a similar crisis in May 2024 that went unnoticed.

items.title: 32-member delegation of 15 federations meets Labour Minister on social security
items.summary: Led by Shri Surendra Kumar Pandey; unorganised-sector social security called the government's top priority.

items.title: BMS welcomes implementation of the Labour Codes
items.summary: BMS extended support to the government, saying the codes benefit unorganised-sector workers.
